description: User-supplied BitPolito team slide. Cropped vector collage over a continuous full-canvas text-free panel background; editable statistics are rebuilt in LaTeX.

parts.name: collage
parts.content: Original collage, brand wordmark, embedded poster lettering and mission badges. Artwork lettering and the QR are part of this replaceable illustration.

parts.name: panels
parts.content: Continuous original full-canvas background with rounded panel geometry, masks, edge fades and clipping; statistic lettering removed.

retained_source: Prepared PDF parts are the retained vector sources; ordinary compilation needs no original export or PDF processing library.
intentional_differences: Four statistics and their captions use editable Inter instead of the original SF Pro outlines.
The reusable template uses a generic fourth caption; the team helper and ready-content example restore the supplied Bitcoin wording.
